evidence: Every commit (initial commit, README, 'second print edition', Jan 2017) is authored by Andreas M. Antonopoulos <andreas@antonopoulos.com>. The README says the source is for the book published by MerkleBloom LLC and that the chapters are licensed CC-BY-NC-ND, and the LICENSE says 'Copyright (c) 2017 merklebloom'. The author granted the license, so verbatim non-commercial redistribution is allowed. The github.com/merklebloom org now only has bookbuilder and docker-asciidoctor, so the original repo seems to have been removed. Consider linking with that caveat.
